prompts.text:
Welcome to LexIntake intake screening.
I will ask a few questions so we can check practice-area fit, deadlines, conflicts, and routing. $legal_disclaimer
$first_question
Thanks — I still need a bit more information to screen this matter.
Please share a short description or answer the last question.

Intake interview complete. Here is the screening summary:
$summary
Return JSON only. No legal advice.

map.item: What type of legal matter is this (e.g., Personal Injury, Employment Law, Immigration)?
In which US state did this occur (e.g., CA, NV, NY)?
What is the incident or event date (YYYY-MM-DD or 'X months ago')?
Who is the opposing or potentially at-fault party?
What are your estimated damages or losses in USD (number)?

prompt.user: Extract intake fields from the user reply into JSON only. Keys: name, opposing_party, practice_area, jurisdiction, incident_date, damages (int|null), severity. Use null for unknown. Current facts: $facts User reply: $text
